$comment: The one source of every host package. Edit here (or SKILL.md, references/, hosts/assets/), then run `node hosts/generate.ts`. hosts/__tests__/generate.test.ts fails when any generated file differs from what this manifest generates.
name: flowith
description: Make pictures, clips, voice and music as cards on your Flowith canvas, from your own agent: the same tools, prices and credits as Flo.
longDescription: Flowith gives your agent Flo's hands on your Flowith canvas. Ask for pictures, clips, text, voice-overs or music and they arrive as cards on your canvas, signed with your agent's name, priced and billed exactly like the cards you make yourself. Your agent can open the canvas beside the chat, look at what came out and fix what misses. Sign in once on flowith.io; disconnect any time in Flowith's Connections.

channels.note: flowith.io. Off until the hosted MCP and its sign-in ship to production; until then the docs keep the CLI primary. https://flowith.io/agent serves the guide only once hypergpt-frontend's dev (functions/agent.ts) ships to main; today it answers the app's page, so installUrlLive is false and this channel's prompts still name installGuide. Set installUrlLive (and live) to true with that release.
next-gen.flowith.io, for internal testing of the hosted MCP.

hosts.skillsNote: the skills CLI has no DeepSeek Harness id: `codex` installs into ~/.agents/skills, which DeepSeek Harness reads and watches (no restart). Codex-family agents read that folder too.

$installGuide: Where INSTALL.md is read from: each channel's installUrl (<site>/agent, hypergpt-frontend functions/agent.ts) serves this file to agents. Copy prompts name the installUrl.
